full_prompt_en: A square, saturated painting looks across a broken rocky plain and shallow winding pools toward an enormous yellow sun on the horizon. The sun sits exactly near the center, half hidden by a low dark strip of distant land. Warm orange, mustard, and scarlet banks spread across the foreground in jagged horizontal plates, interrupted by deep turquoise water channels that snake from the lower middle toward the light. Rounded violet and near-black boulders sit at the left and right edges, with several smaller stones scattered in the pools and on the banks. A bright pale reflection of the sun cuts through a midground water surface, but the broken channels keep it from becoming a single straight path. Farther back, a thin line of small shrubs or trees runs below the sun. Tall rose-purple rock walls rise on both sides of the background, opening a central gap toward the horizon. The sky in that gap is vivid cyan-blue, crowded with small flat coral-pink cloud strips and a few isolated pale circular marks. Fine grain, stippled color, and short layered strokes texture every colored area; edges remain graphic yet visibly painted. Light is low and warm at the horizon, gilding the yellow banks and leaving the purple rocks in darker contrast. The viewpoint is low enough for the foreground plates to feel broad but high enough to see the winding water pattern. The composition leads from the fragmented warm foreground through cool pools to the immense central sun, making color and scale the main drama.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、高饱和绘画越过破碎岩石平原和浅浅蜿蜒水潭，望向地平线上的巨大黄太阳。太阳正好靠近中央，下半部被远处低矮深色地带遮住。暖橘、芥黄和绯红的岸地在前景铺成锯齿状水平板块，被从下部中央向光线延伸的深青绿水道切开。圆润紫色和近黑巨石坐落在左右边缘，较小石块散在水潭与岸上。太阳的浅亮倒影切过一片中景水面，但破碎水道使它不成为笔直通路。再远些，一条小灌木或树线处于太阳下方。玫紫色高岩壁从背景两侧升起，在中央让开面向地平线的缺口。缺口中的天空鲜艳青蓝，挤满扁平珊瑚粉云条和少数独立浅色圆点。细颗粒、点状颜色和短层叠笔触纹理覆盖每块颜色；边缘图形化，却仍明显带绘画痕迹。光在地平线低而温暖，把黄色岸地镀亮，紫岩则留在较深的对比中。视点低到让前景板块显得宽阔，也足以看清蜿蜒的水纹。构图从破碎暖色前景经冷水潭引向巨大的中央太阳，以颜色和尺度为主要戏剧性。
style_prompt_en: Painting uses heavily saturated complementary color and granular layered marks to make a landscape-like field feel both graphic and tactile. Broad jagged warm plates alternate with cool winding bands, creating directional movement without precise perspective. Set orange, saffron, scarlet, and coral against cyan, deep teal, violet, and near-black. A very large simple luminous circle can anchor the center while many smaller fractured shapes animate the foreground. Fine stipple, short strokes, and visible pigment variation enrich flat color areas; edges remain bold and partly irregular. Low warm light can concentrate near the horizon and echo in broken reflections, with darker cool masses holding the sides. The transferable effect is vivid, strange, and expansive, driven by scale contrast, rhythmic fragmentation, and fierce warm-cool exchange.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画以高度饱和的互补色和颗粒层叠痕迹，让类似景观的色场既图形化又有触感。宽阔锯齿状暖色板块与冷色弯带交替，在不依赖精确透视的情况下制造方向动势。以橘、藏红、绯红和珊瑚色对照青蓝、深青绿、紫色与近黑。一枚极大的简单发光圆形可以锚定中央，许多更小的破碎形状活跃前景。细点描、短笔触与颜料色差丰富平涂区域；边缘有力且略不规则。低处暖光可集中在地平线附近并在断续倒影中呼应，较深冷色体量压住两侧。可迁移的效果鲜艳、奇异而开阔，由尺度反差、节奏性碎裂和强烈冷暖往返驱动。
theme_en: An orange and turquoise rocky plain at a giant setting sun
theme_zh: 巨大落日前的橘色与青绿岩石平原
name: Todd James
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
